reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, concat(brand, ' ', UPPER(TRIM(sku))) AS label
FROM products
WHERE category_id IS NULL
alternatives:
WITH cleaned AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, brand, UPPER(TRIM(sku)) AS clean_sku, category_id
  FROM products
)
SELECT product_id, concat(brand, ' ', clean_sku) AS label
FROM cleaned
WHERE category_id IS NULL
SELECT product_id, brand || ' ' || UPPER(TRIM(sku)) AS label FROM products WHERE category_id IS NULL

other_way.sql:
WITH cleaned AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, brand, UPPER(TRIM(sku)) AS clean_sku, category_id
  FROM products
)
SELECT product_id, concat(brand, ' ', clean_sku) AS label
FROM cleaned
WHERE category_id IS NULL
other_way.tradeoff: A step that cleans the sku first keeps the label simple, but one expression is shorter when the label is all you need.
